{{Quote|So no, Novan Nune never faced Huska the Hutt in single combat. But there really was a tale of triumph involving Parcovey Minor, Republic colonists, and some very surprised Hutts getting what they deserved.|Thunys Albegron, Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Parcovey Minor''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Hune sector/Legends|Hune sector]]. During the [[Kymoodon Era]], it was settled by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] from [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]]; however, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] viewed the world as a part of their territories. They ordered a [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|raid]] on Parcovey Minor in order to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] its inhabitants, but the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]], which learned of the planned attack beforehand, was able to repel it. In return, the heavily armed militia members and colonists then launched a surprise attack into [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

The raid was described in a [[Belascoan Archive Report|report]] preserved in a [[Kymoodon-era government archive|government archive]] on Belasco, where it was discovered in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. In [[114 BBY]], a fictionalized version of the raid on Parcovey Minor was featured in an [[Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim|installment]] of the ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]'' [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] series, and [[Academician of Popular Studies]] [[Thunys Albegron]] [[Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|analyzed]] the two accounts during the [[Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|On the small green world of Parcovey Minor, dozens of families have banded together to clear land for a nerf ranch, unaware that the Hutts have decided to make their colony an object lesson for any Republic citizen who would dare trespass on their domain&hellip;|"Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim," ''True Tales of the Ancient Republic''|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
Parcovey Minor was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Parcovey Minor system/Legends|Parcovey Minor system]], a part of the [[Hune sector/Legends|Hune sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> "[[Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim]]," an installment of the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] series ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]'', depicted it as a small, [[Color/Legends|green]] world.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==History==
===Ancient bravery===
{{Quote|According to the Archive Report, a captured Jilruan pirate told the authorities on Belasco of the planned raid on Parcovey Minor. The Belasco Free Volunteers rushed to the colony's defense and were hiding on several ranches when a barque filled with Klatooinian and Weequay raiders attacked.|Thunys Albegron, Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
[[File:BelascoHuttSpace17to12kBBY-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Parcovey Minor (situated in the area Rimward of Nanth'ri) was settled by colonists from Belasco in what the Hutts of Hutt Space considered a part of their outlying domains.]]
At some point during the [[Kymoodon Era]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which lasted from [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] to [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Parcovey Minor, located beyond the frontier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]], was settled by Republic [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] from the world [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]]. Members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] viewed the world as part of outlying Hutt domains and the Republic colonization as an act of war. In response, the Hutts planned a [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|raid]] on Parcovey Minor in order to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] its inhabitants, sending a [[barque]] with [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] raiders aboard to the world.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

However, a captured [[Unidentified Jilruan pirate|Jilruan pirate]] revealed the upcoming raid to the authorities on Belasco, and subsequently the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]] hid on several [[Farm/Legends|ranches]] on Parcovey Minor, setting up an ambush. When the Hutt [[Starship/Legends|barque]] attacked, its occupants were all either [[Death/Legends|killed]] or captured, and when they were later interrogated, divulged their allegiance to the Hutt [[Utoradii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]]. Thereafter, several dozen heavily armed Belasco Free Volunteers members and colonists traveled in the captured Hutt starships to the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> world<ref name="TEA" /> [[Affavan]], where they surprised and attacked members of the Utoradii and [[Vijilakii]] clans who were instead expecting a shipment of terrified enslaved people. The events surrounding the raid on Parcovey Minor were later recorded in a [[Belascoan Archive Report|report]] that was prepared as background for a public advisory against [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] Republic colonization. The report came to rest in a [[Kymoodon-era government archive|government archive]] on Belasco.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

===Fiction and history===
{{Quote|It would have been a cruel revelation for the boys and girls of a century ago to learn that the intrepid Sector Ranger Novan Nune almost certainly never existed&mdash;much less followed the colonists kidnapped on Parcovey Minor to the dreaded arenas of Affavan, deep in Hutt Space, fought as a gladiator to win their freedom, and then returned to destroy the Hutt kajidic that had ravaged their world.|Thunys Albegron, Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
[[File:Nerf-aa.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The colonists of the ''True Tales of the Ancient Republic''{{'s}} fictionalized version of Parcovey Minor worked to establish a ranch for nerfs (a herder with nerfs depicted).]]
In [[114 BBY]], the ''True Tales of the Ancient Republic'' installment "Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim" was released. It depicted a fictionalized version of the raid on Parcovey Minor, mentioning the world in its introductory plot exposition text. In the holodrama, which was set in the final [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the Kymoodon Era, the Hutt attack on the colony, which included multiple families clearing land in order to establish a [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] ranch, was successful, and the enslaved settlers of the ravaged world were transported to Affavan.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Instead of the Belascoan militia, however, in "Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim" the Hutt forces were followed to Affavan by the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] [[Novan Nune]], who fought as a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] in Affavan's arenas to secure the colonists' release and afterward returned to Parcovey Minor in order to defeat the Hutt clan responsible for the raid. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the fragmentary remains of the Belascoan archive report were discovered. Subsequently, the [[Academician of Popular Studies]] [[Thunys Albegron]] [[Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|compared and contrasted]] the fictionalized version of the Parcovey Minor assault and its historical account during the [[Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment]] a [[6 ABY/Legends|year later]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Several dozen militia members and colonists took the captured ships to Affavan, where the slaves from Parcovey Minor were to be sorted and auctioned off, or disposed of at a parlay-feast between clans Utoradii and Vijilakii. Instead of terrified slaves, the assembled Hutts found themselves face to face with Belasco Volunteers who were heavily armed and seeking vengeance.|Thunys Albegron, Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
Parcovey Minor was inhabited by colonists from Belasco who lived on a number of ranches on the world. In "Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim," those colonists were depicted as numbering at least a dozen families, who cooperated in establishing a nerf ranch.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parcovey Minor was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the world was cut before the book's release. That section was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Parcovey Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world itself, in grid square Q-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
